headerDisplay: Control CREATE ceiling fans (Tuya based) over your local network. Each fan needs its Tuya device ID, local key and a static IP address: see [Getting your keys](https://github.com/jasonacox/tinytuya/tree/master#setup-wizard---getting-local-keys).

name.title: Platform name
name.description: Only used in the Homebridge logs.

name.title: Fan name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app.

ip.title: IP address
ip.description: Static IP address of the fan on your local network. Reserve it in your router (DHCP reservation) so it never changes.

id.title: Tuya device ID
id.description: Must be unique per fan. Get it with the tinytuya setup wizard (link at the top of this page).

key.title: Tuya local key
key.description: Get it with the tinytuya setup wizard. It changes every time the fan is re-paired in the Tuya / Smart Life app.

light.title: Expose the light
light.description: Adds a light bulb tile for the fan's light. Turn this off for fan models without a light.

toggles.title: Expose toggle tiles
toggles.description: Adds two 'Toggle' tiles (fan and light). Each tap flips the fan or light on/off, then the tile switches back off by itself. Works from the Home app, scenes, automations and HomeKit remotes.

speedButtons.title: Expose speed up / speed down tiles
speedButtons.description: Adds two tiles that change the speed by one step (1 to 6) on each tap. Speed Up turns the fan on if it was off; Speed Down turns it off when already at step 1.

version.title: Tuya protocol version
version.description: Leave on 3.4 for most CREATE fans (2023 and later). Try 3.3 for older units. A wrong value shows up as 'ECONNRESET' right after connecting.
